title: Regenerate must clear Batch billing attributes once M11 telemetry lands
description:
\`_regenerate_admin_job\` (cdk/lambdas/router/handler.py, from auritus-907209)
REMOVEs every ephemeral attribute that \`_claim_job\`/\`_mark_done\`/\`_mark_failed\`
can write, so a regenerated job starts clean. It predates M11's batch billing
telemetry story (auritus-d43efe / auritus-bb0dac), which adds
\`batch_created_at\`, \`batch_started_at\`, \`batch_stopped_at\`,
\`container_seconds\`, \`provisioning_seconds\`, \`billed_seconds\`,
\`instance_type\`, and later cost fields to job records.

None of those are in the regenerate REMOVE list. Once M11 lands, regenerating
a job that previously ran on Batch will keep its old billing/cost attributes
on the reset record -- a job now genuinely pending would still show a stale
GPU cost from its prior run until it completes again (or forever, if it's
picked up locally instead).

Extend \`_regenerate_admin_job\`'s REMOVE clause to cover the M11 attributes
when that epic's job-record schema exists. Add a regression scenario to
\`features/job_regeneration.feature\` asserting a regenerated job has no
leftover billing attributes.
